search_boundary: Two targeted official-source search groups and three primary-source reads covering named sodium-ion delivery, grid commissioning, customer acceptance and public field performance; not an exhaustive market census.

sources_checked.finding: CATL's latest English news item is a general innovation speech. It does not establish a named sodium-ion BESS delivery, commissioned site, acceptance result or field-performance record.

The page reports a five-year 3 GWh INTILION memorandum and says sodium and lithium routes will advance in parallel. It does not attribute the full tranche to sodium-ion chemistry or establish a named commissioned sodium-ion site, customer acceptance result, operating record or independent performance evidence. Open draft PR 70 already contains the append-only event draft.
INTILION's press-release index did not expose a matching 27 October announcement or newer sodium-ion commissioning record.

provenance_note: Open draft PR 70 remains the append-only record for the 27 October CATL-INTILION item. This review does not duplicate, overwrite or treat that pending record as newly discovered today.
